approach: XenonRecomp static recompilation with a Vulkan renderer at the GPU command-processor level (EDRAM tile model, Xenos shaders to SPIR-V); MoltenVK on iPad
notes: Playable on Windows at 60 fps (menus, training, exhibition matches, sound, saves).
